about:
I'm a Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable web applications — from Design System libraries to full-featured B2B platforms.

My work spans frontend-heavy products using Vue.js, Nuxt.js and React, as well as backend integrations with Node.js and .NET. I care deeply about performance, AI-driven development, and shipping interfaces that feel genuinely good to use.

I work best in collaborative, cross-functional environments where design and engineering share the same goals. I'm also an early adopter of AI-assisted development — I actively use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Claude to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality and code standards.
